title: BossReng's UI Mod
description: Boss_Reng and various Lofi music creators bring you the best visuals and the most comfortable acoustic experience in Minecraft!
body:
### This mod will not be open source due to copyright reasons.

![BossReng's UI Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/642ef117dbec96515cc94770d6f8aa906d7fdd71_0.webp)

## The mod was created in collaboration with **BossReng-GameStudio** and **Lofi Gril**.

**Boss_Reng and various Lofi music creators bring you the best visuals and the most comfortable acoustic experience in Minecraft!**

I created this mod to bring a touch of "poetry" to our blocky world. By collaborating with several talented Lofi artists, I've integrated chill background music with custom rendering effects and smooth UI animations, making the game a much more relaxing place to build and explore.

## ⚠️ Essential Dependencies:
You MUST install the following two mods for this to work, otherwise the game will crash on startup:

1. Water Media (Handles the multimedia rendering)
2. Kotlin for NeoForge (Required language framework)

## ⚙️ Known Bugs & Work-in-Progress:
I'm currently working on a few rendering issues. Please be aware of the following:

### Screen Flickering
When switching between certain interfaces, the screen may flicker once before the transition animation starts.

### Background Coverage
The global background doesn't "hijack" every single screen yet. It is normal to see the vanilla Minecraft background while the game is connecting to a single-player world or a multiplayer server.

_I'm fixing these bugs in my spare time, so thanks for your patience. If you run into any other crashes or issues, feel free to report them._

<details>
<summary>attention please</summary>

Because this mod focuses on modifying the main menu and settings page mixins, custom menus from other mods you have installed may not work or may conflict (they will generally not work because I have written solutions to prevent this). Please do not install any other custom menu mods to avoid unexpected game bugs.

</details>

# Enjoy the vibes!
